messages.author: 12978137d7195b13
messages.subject: Factor
parts:
Being new to R in general can someone please explain the diff for using 

ggplot(aes(factor(Group),value)) +....  

Vs

ggplot(x=Group,y=Value)

? Sorry for what may seem a very naive question.

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: Factor
parts:
Group can be continuous or discrete (a factor). By default, Group seems continuous in your case, and factor() coerces it into discrete units.

Cheers,
Roman
